RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 60

An all-male panel appointing a male candidate with less leadership experience over a more qualified female candidate is a notable red flag for affinity bias. While interview performance and teaching tenure may have weighed in his favor, your five years as deputy principal and relevant master's degree make your credentials substantially stronger on paper.

Do not lead with allegations of sexism yet. First, escalate your request for the written statement, as delayed transparency often signals procedural vulnerabilities. Consult your union or legal counsel to review whether local public sector hiring rules were breached. If you initiate a formal appeal or discrimination claim, cite the panel's gender composition alongside your objective qualifications to demonstrate potential bias.
